extraction_notes: Identity: LCSC C19077403 corresponds to BZT52C6V2, marking code WA, SOD-123 package, on the family datasheet BZT52C2V0 THRU BZT52C75 (www.ichjc.com). SHA-256 of the PDF verified: 1e58426ecb363e87dbad0da3e5a12350aadc7203342e2c339877f1de5b2d7631.
Zener impedance (no dedicated schema slot): ZZT = 10 ohm max at IZT = 5 mA; ZZK = 150 ohm max at IZK = 1.0 mA (p. 2, BZT52C6V2 row). These support the archetype variant-Z NBV/RS derivation.
Typical temperature coefficient at IZT: 0.4 to 3.7 mV/degC; admissible zener current IZM = 5 mA (p. 2, BZT52C6V2 row).

Ratings (p. 1): PD = 350 mW at Ta = 25 degC, RthJA = 357 degC/W, Tj and Tstg = -55 to +150 degC. Note Fig. 1 curves are drawn against a PD = 500 mW pulsed envelope, which exceeds the 350 mW continuous rating; digitized points are kept at or below 30 mA (0.19 W at 6.2 V).

Curve digitization method: page 3 rasterized at 200 dpi; axes calibrated from gridline pixel positions (x: 1 V at px 197, 53.1 px/V linear; y: 100 mA at row 284, 213.4 px/decade log). The branch labeled 6.2 is cleanly separated from the neighboring 5.6 and 6.8 branches at every sampled current. Stroke width about 3 px gives roughly +/-0.03 V reading uncertainty; values rounded to 0.01 V. The branch terminates on the power envelope between 30 and 50 mA, so no points were taken above 30 mA.

Digitization sanity checks: digitized VZ at IZT = 5 mA is 6.13 V, inside the table band 5.89 to 6.51 V; implied incremental impedance from 5 to 30 mA is about 3 ohm, consistent with ZZT max 10 ohm; local slope near 1 mA is about 19 ohm, well under ZZK max 150 ohm.

Forward data: the only forward point is VF = 0.9 V max at IF = 10 mA from the maximum ratings table (p. 1); the datasheet has no forward IV figure, so low-current recombination cannot be fitted from this sheet.

Capacitance: p. 3 has a family-level typical capacitance vs nominal zener voltage figure (0 V bias, 1 V bias, 50 percent VZ bias, f = 1 MHz), but at VZ = 6.2 the three curves and their label arrows are not separable with confidence in the raster, and the electrical table publishes no capacitance value; capacitance is therefore omitted rather than guessed.
No reverse recovery time is published anywhere on the datasheet.
